findings.title: Documented global F1–F8 shortcuts are dropped in the modal domain

requirement.quote: F-keys are global; printable keys remain editor data.

evidence: commands.cj:60-61 forwards only f9/f10 to action and consumes them.
preview.cj:16 and commands.cj:41 install modalKey for Preview and its PopupMenu.
src/application.cj:400-402 stops the bubble path at the modal root; :436-443 only invokes application key handlers when modal.isNone().
main.cj:18 registers all remaining F-key actions exclusively with app.onKeyEvent.
findings.consequence: With Classic accepted, F5 then F2 cannot request Dark; the same occurs after Enter opens the owned popup. F6/F7 load/reload and F8 scrolling also do nothing until the modal closes. This contradicts the frozen global-key contract and prevents live theme operations while inspecting the modal.
findings.bounded_fix: Dispatch the documented F1–F10 actions from the modal-domain handler using the existing action method, consume handled F-keys once, retain the already-open Preview guard and popup ownership, and leave ordinary editor/menu keys to their existing handlers. Add independent real-key regressions for Preview and its owned popup before fixing.
findings.proof_scope: Confirmed by fixed-source dispatch/control-flow inspection; reviewer ran no build, test or runtime command. Existing frozen PTY suite switches before opening Preview and has no F1–F8-in-modal assertion.

other_source_assessment: Public declarative gallery, relative dependency, all four presets and widget/state slots, actual-size weighted layout, pure tracked loader reads, current accepted-file reload, retained controllers/nodes, popup owner ancestry, disabled controls, and one entity per file show no additional blocking source finding.
